description: Which of these IPs fall inside which CIDR ranges (allowlist / blocklist check). Checks up to 1,000 IPs against up to 1,000 CIDR blocks (IPv4 and IPv6) and returns, per IP, every matching range. Invalid entries are reported, not fatal. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
